done_tasks.po_routing_ruling_20260721: PO ARTIFACT-CLASS ROUTING RULING 2026-07-21T18:42Z. Rule: routing follows ARTIFACT CLASS, not directory. Any row whose deliverable is instruction-prose that an agent LOADS AND EXECUTES — .claude/agents/**, docs/agents/** (init/flow/knowledge/tools-package), .claude/skills/**/SKILL.md — routes to agent-father. Executable code (apps/**, scripts/**), codegen-from-registry, and data/root-config (docs/data/**, CLAUDE.md) route to zone-matched dev-* or developer. Rationale: for this system a flow doc IS the executable source; agent-father is already sole owner of agent-file lifecycle (dispatch/SKILL.md:48) and of NEW cron skill files (:50), and board precedent has 5/5 pre-existing docs/agents/ rows routed to agent-father/agents-architect/po and 0 to developer. Precedent for SKILL.md specifically: docs/signals/processed/dev-team-20260716T102429Z-autolaunch-safety-hold-uc-asl-p6.json already routed a signal-dashboard SKILL.md edit to agent-father as 'the factory rule'. ROOT CAUSE this closes: .claude/skills/zone-detect/SKILL.md resolves ONLY dev-<service> (Tier-1/2, needs apps/<service>/-shaped zone) or generic developer (Tier-3 fallback) — it has NO path to agent-father, so any docs/agents/ or .claude/skills/ row reaching execute-tier with next_agent unset gets the 'developer' placeholder and mis-routes. EXPECTED SIDE EFFECT (do NOT 'fix' this): next_agent=agent-father does not match the dev-role pattern ^dev(-|$)|^developer$, so the BOUNDED-1 NON-DEV-NEXT_AGENT gate (dev-team/flow/main.md:518) now WITHHOLDS these rows from unattended idle auto-pickup. That is the intended outcome — they require deliberate router dispatch to agent-father, not silent promotion to a generic developer.
